snippet.title: PlayStation - Bugriders - The Race of Kings (1997)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
Leptus is dying, and the tournament is on to succeed him as the Emperor of Entymion. Enter the hi-resolution hive of insane insect racing and fly the unfriendly skies!
